docs.name: Forest Studio Hospitality
docs.description: A property-management and booking platform for independent stays — hotels, homestays, hostels, dorms, villas. Hard-forked from a mature engine and rebuilt: full de-brand, in-house kitchen operations, per-bed dorm inventory, iCal channel sync, a guest site and a back office. Live demo of a Coonoor bungalow.

docs.name: PhytoStore
docs.description: A multi-tenant e-commerce platform, Shopify-like, for plant sellers across India. Subscriptions, wallet and rewards, product combos, a native Android app, admin in ten Indian languages.

docs.name: Adam-EEG / AI Circuit Platform
docs.description: An open-source 32-channel EEG board I designed in 2015 (quad ADS1299, dual ATmega328), now the foundation for an AI-native circuit design platform — natural language to schematic to PCB to manufacturing files.

docs.name: adam
docs.description: A programming language, designed from a written specification before a line of implementation existed. Compiles to C99. Memory strategy — owned, borrowed, reference-counted, garbage-collected — is part of the type system, not bolted on.

docs.name: OnlyFarm
docs.description: A hyperlocal marketplace connecting Tamil Nadu farmers directly with buyers, cutting out the middleman layer that eats most of a small farmer's margin.

docs.name: CP Market Intelligence
docs.description: Market analytics for the carnivorous-plant industry — price tracking, listing aggregation, and species data, built to answer questions the industry has never had real data for.

docs.name: Learning Platform
docs.description: Course platform for tissue-culture and plant-biotechnology training, with question banks, UPI payments, and real certification — the knowledge to do this well is scattered and expensive.

docs.name: Encrypted Notes
docs.description: A single HTML file. No server-side database — GitHub is the only backend, and everything is encrypted client-side before it ever leaves the browser.

docs.name: Private tools
docs.description: The rest — chat apps, a life-simulation game, AI terminals, note-taking systems, and whatever I am tinkering with at 1am.
